mentions.name: Splorbit
mentions.description: Splorbit is a bullet heaven game featuring high enemy density and juicy ball physics, built entirely with web tech and playable in the browser. Its goal is to revive direct-to-audience web game distribution without platforms like Steam or app stores.
mentions.problem: The author is frustrated with platforms like Steam and app stores that take 30% and have broken discovery, and wants to return to the good old days of web gaming with direct distribution to the audience.
mentions.audience: Web game players who play directly in the browser
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Splorbit - a bullet heaven game with high enemy density and juicy ball physics. It's built enitrely with web tech so you can play it right now in your browser: https://splorbit.vercel.app/
